title: MetadataConfiguration contains metadata about the LXD server configuration options.

configs.description: Configs contains all server configuration metadata.

entities.description:
Entities contains all authorization related metadata.

API extension: metadata_configuration_entity_types

condition.description: Condition describes conditions under which the configuration key can be applied.

defaultdesc.description: DefaultDescription contains a description of the configuration key.

longdesc.description: LongDescription contains a long-form description of the configuration key.

managed.description: Managed describes whether the configuration key is managed by LXD.

required.description: Required describes conditions under which the configuration key is required.

scope.description:
Scope describes the cluster member specificity of a configuration key. Options marked with a `global` scope are applied to all cluster members. Options marked with a `local` scope are set on a per-member basis.

API extension: metadata_configuration_scope

shortdesc.description: ShortDescription contains a short-form description of the configuration key.

type.description: Type describes the type of the key.

MetadataConfigurationConfigKey.title: MetadataConfigurationConfigKey contains metadata about a LXD server configuration option.

MetadataConfigurationConfigKeys.title: MetadataConfigurationConfigKeys contains metadata about LXD server configuration options.

entitlements.description: Entitlements contains a list of entitlements that apply to a specific entity type.

project_specific.description: ProjectSpecific indicates whether the entity is project specific.

MetadataConfigurationEntity.title: MetadataConfigurationEntity contains metadata about LXD server entities and available entitlements for authorization.

name.description: Name contains the name of the entitlement.

MetadataConfigurationEntityEntitlement.title: MetadataConfigurationEntityEntitlement contains metadata about a LXD server entitlement.
